title: Harold Malmgren: NHI track the frontier of human innovation

tellings.quote: Why did a presidential adviser named Harold Melmgrren who worked [music] directly with JFK, LBJ, Nixon, and Ford and who was briefed on UFOs, why did [music] he tell me that this is how the nonhuman intelligences operate by tracking the frontier of human innovation?

plain: Non-human intelligences are said to operate by watching the cutting edge of human invention, according to a presidential adviser named Harold Malmgren. Michels says Malmgren told him this himself, and describes him as an adviser who worked directly with Presidents Kennedy, Johnson, Nixon and Ford and who was briefed on UFOs. If true, it would mean whatever is visiting is drawn to wherever human technology is advancing fastest.
